facts.text: I am thinking of taking my new hybrid bike to trails on the weekend.
I have a Trek FX 2 hybrid bike.
I lent my road bike to my neighbor Rachel.
Rachel borrowed my Cannondale Synapse from February 20th to March 1st.
I am planning to ride on rough trails this weekend.
I plan to set my tire pressure to around 65 PSI for rough trails.
Rachel returned my Cannondale Synapse on March 1st with a flat tire.
I still need to fix the flat tire on my Cannondale Synapse.
I am thinking of cleaning my hybrid bike this weekend.
I am especially planning to clean the wheels on my hybrid bike.
My hybrid bike wheels have been getting quite dirty.
I am planning to apply a coat of waterproofing to the chain and gears this weekend.
I am thinking of organizing my garage where I store my bikes.
I store my bikes in my garage.
I am thinking of getting a bike rack for my car.
My car is a Honda Civic.
I want to transport my bikes more easily to different trails and parks.
I am considering the Saris Bones 2-Bike Trunk Rack.
